verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 is a physical GPU purchased and installed in a user's own workstation—self-hosting is its native mode of operation. Docs explicitly market running LLMs, fine-tuning, and autonomous AI agents 'locally and securely' without cloud/data-center reliance, and community evidence corroborates real hands-on multi-GPU local deployments achieving high local inference throughput. Missing for 10: no first-party self-hosting guide/tutorial beyond marketing copy, and some community concerns about power/cost for local setups.
